name: Abstract Email Validation
tagline: Validate and verify email addresses for deliverability and risk.
description: AbstractAPI's Email Validation API checks whether an email address is valid, deliverable, and low-risk. It returns quality scores, disposable/free provider flags, MX/SMTP checks, and autocorrect suggestions so apps can reduce bounces and fake signups without sending mail.

auth.details: API key via query parameter `api_key` (self-serve dashboard signup).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan available; exact request quotas vary by plan (see pricing page).
pricing.paid_plans: Paid tiers by monthly validation volume; see abstractapi.com pricing.

use_cases: validate email on user signup before creating account
detect disposable or free email addresses
score email deliverability risk for CRM imports
suggest autocorrect for common email typos
filter fake emails from form submissions
